test_resolve_runtime_provider: test the resolve_runtime_provider function to resolve API credentials for a requested provider like openai-codex, anthropic, or openrouter
test_resolve_provider_alias: test the resolve_provider function to verify provider alias resolution for qwen-portal and qwen-cli maps to qwen-oauth
test_custom_provider_resolution: test custom provider resolution to ensure config.yaml base_url and api_key take priority over environment variables
test_named_custom_provider: test named custom provider resolution to verify custom_providers entries load base_url, api_key, model, and api_mode from config
test_auto_fallback_auth_failure: test auto mode fallback behavior when credential resolution fails with AuthError to fall through to OpenRouter
test_anthropic_pool_base_url: test anthropic provider resolution to verify config base_url overrides pool entry base_url
test_openrouter_key_priority: test that OPENROUTER_API_KEY takes priority over OPENAI_API_KEY when resolving openrouter credentials
